comments.text:
I just tried Marathon with a friend for the Server Slam...We're also newcomers to not only this game but the extraction looter shooter...This game is overwhelming at first. I thought you could just go straight into team death match, not the case. Lots and lots of information slammed into your face. Everything is super confusing for a bit until you get a few runs under your belt. The classes and contracts and agencies are interesting...but again There's a lot to take in. 1 thing I had noticed in the runs, the NPC's are just as strong as the enemy team, you aren't master chief or a tank, you can die pretty easily.

On the plus side, it is really fun once you start understanding the game loop. The art style is super interesting imo. But I worry that there won't be enough content or that the first few hours will just overwhelm players and they will choose another game. Cuz at least with High Guard(After the mandatory Tutorial) you could at least jump right into it. The UI layout for Marathon is confusing as fuck too.

is it worth $40? hard to say. Maybe ill feel different after I put in more time today. I like it but there is a learning curve.
comments.author: @bladelazoe
